headline: NeoGenomics, a US cancer diagnostics laboratory group, is expanding its partnership with Indica Labs to run its digital pathology and AI-based diagnostics on a cloud platform.
score_reason: Pool 5, lowered to 4: the deal was announced on 15 Oct, before the window, and benefits are the companies' own claims.
importance_line: Pathologists and cancer patients whose samples are analysed in these labs may see faster, more consistent results in time, as may the lab and the software maker, but this is a company announcement, the platform is not FDA cleared for diagnosis in the US, and no results are reported.
summary: Clinical Lab Products reports that NeoGenomics and Indica Labs, a digital pathology software company, said in a release that NeoGenomics has chosen Indica's HALO AP platform, a cloud-based, vendor-neutral image system that can host AI tools from other makers or built in-house. The companies say it will give pathologists more consistent workflows and prepare NeoGenomics for rising testing demand tied to antibody-drug conjugate cancer drugs, though in the US the platform is labelled for research use only and is not FDA cleared for clinical diagnosis.
notes: Rests on the companies' joint release of 15 Oct 2026 (Business Wire); event date is before the window.
